metadata.description: Brian Moriarty's Claude skills: a job-search assistant, a voice validator, a code-review control plane, and a memory-seeded worldbuilding engine.

plugins.name: kochab
plugins.description: A personalized resume-based job-search assistant that runs a recurring scan and everything downstream of it: tailoring, study plans, interview prep, and pipeline tracking. You always send.

plugins.name: pherkad
plugins.description: A voice validator that checks whether a draft still sounds like you, with a dependency-free linter for AI-writing tells. Sibling of Kochab.

plugins.name: algol
plugins.description: A review control plane for Claude Code: govern how a project reviews code, reconcile findings into one governed record, and keep each human decision with the conditions that would reopen it. It reviews nothing itself.

plugins.name: worldbuild
plugins.description: Build a fictional universe on disk that is seeded from your own memory, then masked and transposed into myth. Includes a memory-interrogation protocol, a registry for questions the world must never answer, and a lineage check that every entry traces back to something a human supplied.
